subject.title: fix(reef): restore inbox recovery after gateway restart

question: Must this PR provide redacted public after-fix Reef restart evidence, or may a qualifying maintainer accept the referenced private production diagnostics as a proof override?
rationale: Automation can verify tests and source structure but cannot inspect the omitted private runtime evidence or establish that the corrected recovery path worked in the contributor's real relay environment.

options.title: Require redacted after-fix proof
options.body: Ask for a sanitized gateway restart transcript or live output showing socket connection, catch-up from the stored cursor, final connected status, and no duplicate observable delivery.

options.title: Grant a proof override
options.body: A qualifying maintainer who has inspected the private diagnostics may explicitly accept them as sufficient real behavior evidence.

options.title: Pause for a Reef environment
options.body: Keep the PR open until an owner-controlled relay environment can reproduce the restart and upgrade scenarios without exposing private operational data.

recommendation.title: Require redacted after-fix proof
recommendation.body: Ask for a sanitized gateway restart transcript or live output showing socket connection, catch-up from the stored cursor, final connected status, and no duplicate observable delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the available production diagnosis and implemented the recovery path, although any proof override should be confirmed by a qualifying maintainer.
